stories.headline: Musk’s X Money App Moves Closer to Public Debut
stories.body: Elon Musk’s payments-and-banking-focused “everything app” is reportedly moving closer to reality amid multiple unanswered questions. As Bloomberg News reported Sunday (April 26), X Money, an offshoot of social media platform X, is expected to make an early public debut imminently, according to the schedule Musk offered in March.
